notes: The printed equation (1.01)^1474 = 14.7 is false as written: its left side is 2.34e6. 14.7 is the additive 1,474 x 0.01 = 14.74 (or ln of the ratio, 14.67), and 1,570 the additive 157,000 x 0.01; their quotient 106.5 (107.0 via 14.67) matches the printed 107 within 0.5%, so the shortfall exceeding 100-fold survives on the additive or log reading (R4 X1: label slip, ledger). On the multiplicative reading the paper's s3.1 states, the gap is 10^672. The +-3.72 sigma is the 1 - 1/N normal quantile (3.719), not the expected maximum of N draws. Whether the all-beneficial genotype is the required target (critic) is a modelling question this record does not settle; R4 F2 found no saturation at 272 active loci with r = 1/2. Day's 'remain entirely correct' (Ge q1) is about G's external verdict (contested), not this arithmetic.
